# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: IncludeRequestPayload
message: Removed in 3.0 (deprecated since 2.0); use MaxRequestBodySize instead.

name: DiagnosticsLogger
message: Option renamed to DiagnosticLogger in 3.0; use DiagnosticLogger.

name: BeforeSend
message: Removed in 4.0 (was obsolete); use SetBeforeSend instead.

name: BeforeSendTransaction
message: Removed in 4.0; use SetBeforeSendTransaction instead.

name: BeforeBreadcrumb
message: Removed in 4.0; use SetBeforeBreadcrumb instead.

name: CreateHttpClientHandler
message: Removed in 4.0; use CreateHttpMessageHandler instead.

name: ReportAssemblies
message: Removed in 4.0; use ReportAssembliesMode instead.

name: DebugDiagnosticLogger
message: Removed in 4.0; use TraceDiagnosticLogger instead.

name: DisableTaskUnobservedTaskExceptionCapture
message: Removed in 4.0; use DisableUnobservedTaskExceptionCapture instead.

name: SentrySdk.CaptureUserFeedback
message: Removed in 6.0; use SentrySdk.CaptureFeedback instead.

name: BreadcrumbLevel.Critical
message: Renamed to BreadcrumbLevel.Fatal in 6.0.

name: IsEnvironmentUser
message: Defaults to false on MAUI from 6.0, so User.Name is no longer set to the device name; set it explicitly to restore the old behavior.

name: EnableCocoaSdkTracing
message: Renamed to EnableTracing in 4.0 for iOS and MacCatalyst.

name: EnableAndroidSdkTracing
message: Renamed to EnableTracing in 4.0 for Android.

name: EnableAndroidSdkBeforeSend
message: Renamed to EnableBeforeSend in 4.0 for Android.

name: ProfilingEnabled
message: Removed in 4.0 (iOS/Android option); use ProfilesSampleRate instead.

name: EnableFileIOTracking
message: Removed in 4.0 (iOS/Android option); use EnableFileIOTracing instead.

name: EnableCoreDataTracking
message: Removed in 4.0 (iOS option); use EnableCoreDataTracing instead.

name: EnableOutOfMemoryTracking
message: Removed in 4.0 (iOS option); use EnableWatchdogTerminationTracking instead.

name: EnableUIViewControllerTracking
message: Removed in 4.0 (iOS option); use EnableUIViewControllerTracing instead.

name: Sentry.Azure.Functions.Worker
message: Deprecated in 6.0; the integration was replaced by a sample that uses the OpenTelemetry package.
